title: C-VARC: A Large-Scale Chinese Value Rule Corpus for Value Alignment of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring models' value alignment by comparing their preference for multiple-choice options generated from Chinese value rules (C-VARC) versus Western-centric value rules (SC101/MIC) across sensitive moral and societal themes, as well as analyzing their choices in automated rule-driven moral dilemmas to identify cultural value orientations.
